Across his four-decade career, Adams has sold over 100 million records and logged five Top 10 albums on the Billboard 200, including his chart-topping 1984 smash Reckless. He has reached the top of the Billboard Hot 100 four times and earned No. 1 hits in more than 40 countries. He has earned recognition from institutions like the Grammy Awards and American Music Awards, landing nominations for three Academy Awards and five Golden Globes. Outside of his solo work, Adams has collaborated with the likes of Tina Turner, Sting and Celine Dion, and in 2018, he debuted his co-written musical adaptation of Pretty Woman on Broadway. Between 2022 and 2023, Adams released seven full-length projects, including his fifteenth studio album, So Happy It Hurts. After kicking off in ​​St. Louis, Missouri, the Grammy-winning artist will make additional stops in Houston, Orlando, Buffalo and more before wrapping up in mid-August with a show in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. From there, Adams will play additional dates in Canada in August and September.Add Bryan Adams to your favorites on Ticketmaster.com(Opens in new tab) or in the Ticketmaster App to get important alerts about his concerts. (Download the Ticketmaster App for iPhone(Opens in new tab) or Android(Opens in new tab).)The second leg of Bryan Adams’ U.S. Roll With The Punches Tour starts on Friday, July 24 at Enterprise Center in St. Louis, Missouri.Pat Benatar and Neil Giraldo will join Bryan Adams as special guests on all U.S. dates, while Lights will serve as the special guest on select dates of the Canadian leg of the tour.Tickets for the newly-added dates on Bryan Adams’ Roll With The Punches Tour will be available for purchase via Ticketmaster.Various presales will take place in the days leading up to the general ticket sale, including a Citi cardmember presale and Verizon Access presale that begin on Tuesday, March 24 at 10:00 a.m. local time. An artist presale will then take place on Wednesday, March 25 at 10:00 a.m. local time, followed by presales for local venues and a Live Nation presale on Thursday, March 26 at 10:00 a.m. local time.
